第一卷 第257章 小安破化神（第1页）
李寒山将断剑横在身前，感知着那层伪装被斩开后的气息变化——她的修为依旧是化神二层，但灵力运转的细节明显与之前不同，暗紫色的眼眸中带着一种被揭穿后的羞恼与阴郁。
他开口道："阴婆婆，你这张脸，可比那副老皮顺眼多了。怎么，阴泉宗现在连化神女修都要扮成老妪才能出门？"
阴灵月——她已经不再掩饰自己的身份——冷冷地盯着他，嘴角浮现出一丝冰冷的弧度："少废话。就算你看到了本座的真容，也改变不了你被困在阵中的事实。你那些手段，本座已经看透了。"
她说着，从袖中取出一枚通体漆黑、表面流转着细密血纹的符箓，猛地捏碎。
一股狂暴到极点的阴煞之力从符箓中涌出，灌入银尸体内。
那银尸的气息在这一瞬间骤然暴涨，胸口的符文核心亮起刺目的黑光，如同被点燃的火山，以远超之前的速度和力量朝李寒山扑来。那一扑带起的劲风将地面刮出两道深深的沟壑，碎石飞溅如雨。
李寒山断剑横挡，火盾在身前凝聚，却被银尸一爪拍得裂痕密布，整个人被震得连退数步，左臂上的经脉传来一阵更加明显的刺痛。
阴灵月没有给他喘息的机会，第二道术法紧随其后，灰色的阴煞锁链从她掌心激射而出，缠向他的脚踝。
神魂之剑虽然犀利，但连续动用的威能会变差，对阴灵月这等化神的威胁会变得极小。
阴灵月显然也察觉到了这一点——她的攻势越来越猛烈，不断压缩他的活动空间，逼他不得不用纯阳之火持续抵挡。
"你还能撑多久？"她的声音带着压制不住的冷厉，暗紫色的眼眸中满是胜券在握的笃定，"你的神识之剑确实可怕，但本座已经有了防备。等你灵力耗尽，我看你还拿什么来挡！"
她说着，再次催动银尸发起猛攻。利爪、术法、阴煞锁链轮番上阵，将李寒山逼得连连后退。她自己也在不断发出攻击。
像阴灵月，她有一个化神级的银尸，还有大量元婴巅峰的半步银尸。
这些半步银尸，化神一、二层的修士，若没有足够犀利的法宝，也难以直接将它们击毁，它们的数量一多，就非常难缠。
也就李寒山手里有那把犀利的断剑，再加上纯阳之火的克制，才能够让阴灵月的群攻战术难以生效。
现在，就算有断剑，在长时间的战斗之下，李寒山也快要坚持不住了。
他的气息在持续下降，纯阳之火的光芒开始出现细微的明灭——那是灵力接近枯竭的征兆。但每一次被逼到绝境时，他都会从袖中取出一枚回元丹吞下，将那股正在枯竭的灵力重新续上一截。

阴灵月看到他那副依旧从容的模样，气极反笑。她正要从袖中取出最后一张底牌，准备发动致命一击——阵中那道被阴煞之力层层包围的幽蓝色身影，忽然亮了起来。
小安的魂体表面爆发出一道耀眼的幽蓝色光芒。那光芒如同深海中升起的明月，穿透了阵壁、穿透了阴煞之力，将整座河谷映照成一片幽蓝。
她的气息在这一刻跨越了那道横亘已久的门槛，如同一柄被反复淬炼的利刃终于开锋，爆发出的威压让整座暗红色大阵都剧烈震颤起来。
小安缓缓睁开眼，那双幽绿色的眼眸中倒映着化神初期的光晕，她站起身来，周身缭绕的阴气深沉如水。
她看向阴灵月，声音平静却带着一股锐利的锋芒："前辈，接下来——交给我吧。"

Volume 1 Chapter 257 Xiaoan breaks the God of Transformation (Page 1)
Li Hanshan held the broken sword in front of him, feeling the changes in the aura after the layer of disguise was cut away - her cultivation was still at the second level of Shen Transformation, but the details of the spiritual power operation were obviously different from before. There was a kind of shame and gloom in her dark purple eyes after being exposed.
He said: "Grandma Yin, your face is much more pleasing to the eye than that old face. Why, now even the female cultivator of the Yinquan Sect has to dress up as an old woman before she can go out?"
Yin Lingyue - she no longer concealed her identity - stared at him coldly, a cold arc appeared at the corner of her mouth: "Stop talking nonsense. Even if you see my true appearance, it can't change the fact that you are trapped in the formation. I have already seen through your methods."
As she spoke, she took out a dark talisman with fine blood lines flowing on its surface from her sleeve, and crushed it violently.
An extremely violent force of evil surged out of the talisman and poured into the silver corpse.
The breath of the silver corpse suddenly surged at this moment, and the rune core on the chest lit up with a dazzling black light, like a ignited volcano, and rushed towards Li Hanshan with a speed and power far exceeding before. The strong wind brought by that blow blew two deep ravines on the ground, and the gravel splashed like rain.
Li Hanshan's broken sword blocked him, and the fire shield condensed in front of him. However, he was slapped with a claw from the Silver Corpse and was covered in cracks. His whole body was shocked and he took several steps back. A more obvious stinging pain came from the meridians on his left arm.
Yin Lingyue didn't give him a chance to breathe. The second spell followed closely, and the gray Yin Sha chain shot out from her palm and wrapped around his ankle.
Although the Soul Sword is sharp, its power will become worse if it is used continuously, and the threat to gods like Yin Lingyue will become extremely small.
Yin Lingyue obviously noticed this - her offensive became more and more fierce, constantly compressing his movement space, forcing him to use pure Yang fire to continue to resist.
"How long can you hold on?" Her voice was uncontrollably cold and stern, and her dark purple eyes were full of certainty of victory. "Your sword of consciousness is indeed terrifying, but I am already on guard. When your spiritual power is exhausted, I will see what else you can use to block it!"
She said, urging the Silver Corpse to attack again. Sharp claws, spells, and evil chains took turns, forcing Li Hanshan to retreat continuously. She herself kept attacking.
Like Yin Lingyue, she has a silver corpse at the level of a god, and a large number of half-step silver corpses at the peak of Nascent Soul.
These half-step silver corpses, monks on the first and second levels of spiritual transformation, would be difficult to destroy directly without a sharp enough magic weapon. Once their number increased, they would be very difficult to deal with.
Only the sharp broken sword in Li Hanshan's hand, coupled with the restraint of Pure Yang Fire, could make it difficult for Yin Lingyue's group attack tactics to take effect.
Now, even with the Broken Sword, Li Hanshan could hardly hold on after a long battle.
His aura continued to decline, and the light of the pure Yang fire began to flicker and flicker - that was a sign that his spiritual power was approaching exhaustion. But every time he was forced into a desperate situation, he would take out a recovery pill from his sleeve and swallow it, renewing the depleting spiritual power.
Yin Lingyue laughed angrily when she saw his still calm look. She was about to take out the last trump card from her sleeve and prepare to launch a fatal blow - the blue figure in the formation, surrounded by layers of evil power, suddenly lit up.
A dazzling blue light erupted from the surface of Xiao An's soul body. The light was like the bright moon rising from the deep sea, penetrating the walls of the formation and the power of evil spirits, reflecting the entire valley into a deep blue.
Her breath crossed over at this momentCrossing the threshold that had been standing for a long time, it was like a sharp blade that had been tempered repeatedly and finally opened. The burst of pressure made the entire dark red formation tremble violently.
Xiao An slowly opened her eyes, her green eyes reflecting the halo of the early stage of spiritual transformation. She stood up, and the Yin energy surrounding her body was as deep as water.
She looked at Yin Lingyue, and her voice was calm but with a sharp edge: "Senior, leave the next step to me."
